original.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 HelmRepository CRD schema, `status.artifact.digest` is now a required field, so HelmRepository objects that omit it are rejected.

decision.reason: The computed CRD diff between [ev-782bc47d120d] (v2.6.4) and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] (v2.7.0) shows that status.artifact.digest is now required in the HelmRepository source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema, and the validators confirmed this. Because the requirement sits under status.artifact, it only applies to objects that have an artifact, so an object is exposed when status.artifact is set and status.artifact.digest is unset. P1's broader condition would also flag objects that have no artifact. The proposed condition is the same as the one in the earlier known fact vf-6b42bbdfb00a.
